articles.title: Kennedy Family Members Sue to Stop Construction of Trump Arch
articles.summary: The Kennedys have sued to stop construction of President Donald Trump’s “triumphal” arch . On Tuesday, nine members of the dynastic political family filed a motion in federal court in Washington, D.C., to block the arch from being built, arguing that it would obstruct views of the family’s gravesites at Arlington National Cemetery, including that of President John F. articles.title: House Republicans Block Hegseth Impeachment, but Democrats Could Revive Effort in January
articles.summary: The Republican-led House on Tuesday narrowly rejected a push to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over unauthorized military hostilities in Iran, Venezuela and Yemen, shielding one of President Donald Trump's closest allies from an immediate reckoning but setting the stage for a renewed confrontation when Democrats take control of Congress in January. articles.title: Climate Leaders Toast to a Hopeful Future at TIME100 Impact Dinner at COP31

articles.title: How Israel Will Choose Its Next Prime Minister, Explained
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog on Sunday tasked Gadi Eisenkot , a former military chief and the leader of the center-right Yashar party, with forming the country’s next government. It’s the first of several steps necessary to determine the next Prime Minister—but a potentially months-long process could leave Benjamin Netanyahu in power for the foreseeable future.
